node.evidence: A real 939776-byte header-encrypted archive has two independent solid blocks. One packed-data byte in the first block is flipped: the reader returns structured data-corrupt without partial content, opens the second body byte-identically and recovers with the complete archive. Isolated py7zr 1.0.0 independently returns LZMAError for the first block and extracts the same second and complete-first hashes.

wechat-devtools.evidence: SDK3.16.2 used WXWebAssembly and the live modular reader component: two password submissions, two unlock calls, three member opens and three rendered snapshots. The damaged first member showed a readable data-integrity state without clearing the verified password or two-entry directory; the independent second member and complete first member opened their real HTML bodies. The legacy full-suite nested skin selectors remain to be migrated. Not a native nested-control tap, physical iOS/Android or OS picker validation.

mutationQueue.reproduction: Native callbacks preserve LF/CR/TAB/BS member identity; 68 body cases, independent native/tar oracles and 19 actual WeChat WXML taps passed before upload through Actions33415602940.
Valid ZIP names and comments caused false failures; separated output streams and used actual command status, preserving genuine CRC errors.
Seven regressions fail before fix; -spd plus -- selects literal names. Observed MEMFS confirms only selected file is emitted.

Seven original regressions fail before fix; preserve all directory entries, native ordinal selection and CRC validation return each corresponding body. Missing-password then duplicate selection adds an independent EOF regression.
RAR4 public testlink now resolves to 20111 bytes of real HTML identical to bsdtar; RAR5 symbolic/hard/directory links have independent samples. Remaining link variants are tracked in rar.json.

A 12KB solid archive can require more than 80MB of decoded-prefix work before a 36-byte HTML target. The reader uses native solid-block boundaries, permits the exact limit, disables limit+1, resets at new blocks, and preserves target-first access.

No product defect found. Missing/wrong/correct password, exact 80MB, 80MB+1, target-first, numeric volumes, ordinary-archive recovery, independent py7zr decryption and actual WeChat WXML controls all preserved the existing policy.

No product defect found. Corrected the deterministic fixture builder so nested paths are archived once from their root, then verified empty directories, top-level/nested zero-byte files and real solid-block resets in Node, py7zr and actual WeChat WXML controls.

The runtime retained up to 10000 identities, but the page permanently sliced logic state to the first 500 members. Full identity is now retained in memory and rendered in 500-row pages. Node and py7zr agree on 2049 encrypted members at 80MB exact and plus one; actual WeChat controls open the 1002nd member from page three.

A damaged encrypted next header previously threw without exit code or diagnostics, degrading to an unknown command failure. Numeric volume names and 7z start/next-header ranges plus CRCs are now checked before password handling without joining the archive or reading directory names.

A correct password first unlocked the encrypted directory, but a later CRC failure in encrypted packed data was classified as password-or-corrupt; the page cleared the already verified password and disabled every encrypted member. The runtime now distinguishes post-unlock packed-data failures, and the page preserves the directory/password so independent blocks remain openable.

Five separately generated header-encrypted archives using LZMA1, Deflate, BZip2, PPMd and Copy passed damaged-member rejection, independent-member hashes, wrong-password recovery and exact/one-byte-over member size limits. SDK3.16.2 live reader events passed for all five methods. py7zr matched normal bodies; one PPMd corrupt ciphertext caused a native SIGBUS in the oracle worker, recorded separately. No new product defect found. This is across-codec coverage, not multiple codecs within one archive.

Three codec pairs, forty independent py7zr member comparisons and reversed three-volume Node cases preserve block boundaries and byte identity. SDK3.16.2 whole/volume LZMA1+PPMd opens preserve the directory and password after damaged-member failure, then show independent and complete HTML. The separate long-HTML batching fix is uploaded through Actions33920545843; physical device coverage remains pending.
